description: Use when implementing event-driven communication between Rust and JavaScript or between windows. Prevents event listener memory leaks from missing unlisten cleanup and payload serialization failures. Covers emit/listen/once patterns, Emitter and Listener traits, global vs window-scoped events, and frontend event API. Keywords: tauri events, emit, listen, unlisten, event payload, Emitter trait, Listener trait, window events.
